headline: Contested Fronts Stir as Base Lines Shift
war_summary: The latest ledger shows the war’s pressure still gathered around a few contested districts, though the map has not moved uniformly. Mooring County is the sharpest new flare, recording seven base events in two hours and 44 in the day; six Warden, five Colonial and one neutral positions now share the field. Linn Mercy has climbed to 38 daily events, with 13 in six hours, while its line stands at ten Colonial bases and one neutral site. Callums Cape remains a major battlefield at 45 events, though its latest two-hour window is quiet; three Warden and four Colonial holdings are recorded. Weathered Expanse has reached 32 events, including ten in six hours, and remains divided among four Wardens, three Colonials and two neutral sites. Marban Hollow is still split three-three with two neutral bases, but its 15 daily events show less recent movement than the preceding edition. Godcrofts has seen seven events, centered on Isawa, while several other fronts report no strategic-base action in 24 hours. Casualty and enlistment rates are cooling on many active fronts, with localized surges still evident.
